response.sql: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg WHERE avg_rate IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_rate, p.avg_rate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_rate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_rate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_rate AS average_fee_rate, excess, rnk AS rank FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3
